subject.title: feat(system-agent): constrain planner JSON output at generation time

question: Should `supportsJsonSchemaResponseFormat` become a supported persisted model-compatibility option for third-party OpenAI-compatible providers, or should constrained planner decoding remain limited to known provider-owned capabilities?
rationale: The new field is accepted by the model catalog and runtime configuration, so maintainers need to choose its durable public compatibility contract rather than treating it as a purely internal transport detail.

options.title: Support the explicit compat capability
options.body: Keep the capability flag, define its provider contract, and require strict-compatible request mapping plus focused configuration and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Restrict to provider-owned detection
options.body: Remove the generic configured capability and enable constrained planner output only for backends whose contracts OpenClaw directly owns and tests.

recommendation.title: Support the explicit compat capability
recommendation.body: Keep the capability flag, define its provider contract, and require strict-compatible request mapping plus focused configuration and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged local-model work and this PR’s implementation both place steipete closest to the proposed provider/planner capability boundary.
